purpose: Prospective common-factory regression on the unchanged ten original Python seeds; no run until prior cohort is terminal/clean and funding is recorded.
changes: Hash-bound read-only reference-file inspection during specification/question correction.
Existing explicit context recovery also handles received length responses in eligible tool sessions.
Only certified pre-dispatch setup-time refusal can use a shorter available timeout.
Separate semantic review is included in submission validation before the same quality-repair worker exits; unique review traces and accounting receipts.
source_policy: Exact original notebook and seed bytes. No past tasks, diagnostics, answers or seed-specific scientific patches in new payloads.

task_policy.solver_timeout_status: Provisional; separately revisitable before solver execution
task_policy.software_choice: Open: alternative tools are allowed if outputs meet the validated public contract; broad implementation independence is not promised.
task_policy.reward: binary; all required checks must pass
task_policy.target: A realistic scientific analysis task with verifiable outputs, rather than reproducing every implementation detail of the notebook.
task_policy.specification_scope: Draft scientific question, supplied input derivations, selected output schemas and proposed comparison rules. Validate rules before solving.
task_policy.endpoint_recovery: Preparation remains append-only. Construction may recover required scientific endpoints by faithful recomputation of unchanged original source calls on the same original inputs and required state, with separate provenance and independent validation. No invented analysis, broken-source repair, changed methods/inputs or silent endpoint omission.

funding: All planned only; verify a real ledger reservation before any dispatch.
completion_criteria: Preserve every outcome on the same frozen factory. Generated-contract defects, infrastructure failures and unresolved comparisons remain failures/incomplete, not supported source rejections. Scientific acceptance still requires all gates; selected successes do not establish held-out generalization.
